title: Windows: Game icon not shown in title bar when switching from initial Fullscreen to Windowed
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.7.stable, 4.8.dev7 ### System information Godot v4.7.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1692) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13700HX (24 threads) - 15.74 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description When set `display/window/size/mode` to **Fullscreen** or **Exclusive Fullscreen** in Project Settings then make a script to switch to **Windowed** mode (or using Alt-Enter in 4.8 at runtime), the icon in window title bar is not shown in runtime. (In contrast, set `display/window/size/mode` to **Windowed** and in runtime switch to **Fullscreen** then **Windowed**, the icon is normally show) ### Workaround My workaround is to force the icon to be set manually. ```gdscript func _ready() -> void: DisplayServer.window_set_mode(DisplayServer.WINDOW_MODE_WINDOWED) DisplayServer.window_set_icon(load("res://icon.svg").get_image()) ``` ### Steps to reproduce 1. Set `display/window/size/mode` to **Fullscreen** or **Exclusive Fullscreen** in Project Settings. 2. Create a scene and attach a script to root node and add the following code ```gdscript func _ready() -> void: DisplayServer.window_set_mode(DisplayServer.WINDOW_MODE_WINDOWED) ``` 3. Run the scene and observe that game icon at title bar is not shown. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [mrp-4.7.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32944511/mrp-4.7.zip)
